scope: Exposed hand-authored development fixtures; not an independent holdout or a superiority gate.
oracle: Expected atoms, charges, coordinates, connectivity and metadata are explicitly declared; neither engine is the oracle. Formal charges use the declared N.4 +1 / other listed atom types neutral projection only.
policy_note: CheMatic checked source-retention/allow_loss policies versus Open Babel default CLI; no equivalent Open Babel policy is asserted. No charge generation or geometry generation flags.

reported_observations.reason: Exact input bytes retained after bounded structural validation; no edits or chemical interpretation promised.
Source representations retained, including any unparsed status columns, formal-charge extensions and geometry stereo; their chemistry is not verified.
Candidate output omits MOL2 layout, comments, header flags and any unparsed optional columns.
Molecule type and other header flags are not emitted. Parsed name and any complete declared partial-charge dataset are checked separately.
Source atom IDs and names are omitted; candidate correspondence is reported separately.
Source MOL2 atom types are reduced to the bounded graph projection; the original typing model is not emitted.
Source atom substructure ownership and names are not emitted.
Source bond IDs and MOL2 tokens such as am, du and nc are not retained as source metadata.
Only N.4 implies +1; other atom-type and extension formal-charge rules are not interpreted. Preserving the projected charge is not verification of source chemistry.
Coordinate-derived and extension stereochemistry are not interpreted or verified.

Candidate output reparsed; explicit atom counts, mapped elements/aromaticity/projected formal charges and mapped bond orders agree. Source chemical interpretation and inferred hydrogens are outside this check.

Reparsed candidate coordinates agree bit for bit with source f64 x/y/z values through verified atom correspondence, including signed zero. Original decimal spelling and physical dimensionality are outside this check.
Reparsed properties.name equals the parsed (trimmed) source molecule name; original header whitespace is accounted for by source_text loss.
Partial-charge preservation requires complete source values, reparsed bitwise equality and verified atom correspondence; no rounding into formal charges or filling missing values.
Source charge-method label retained verbatim as the partialCharges dataset key; the declared method is not recomputed or independently validated.
CJSON formal charges are checked as part of mapped graph verification. This does not validate MOL2 charge interpretation beyond N.4; partial-charge preservation is checked separately.

limitations: Exposed development fixtures, not an independent holdout or superiority gate.
Local MOL2 N.4 formal-charge projection only; generic MOL2 charge interpretation is unverified.
Tiny independent readers cover only this declared fixture profile.
Unlabelled topology plus elements determine correspondence; symmetry/search limits remain unverified.
Opaque marker retention checks bytes only, not editable or interpreted semantics.
OS/system libraries, environment and full runtime dependency closure are not archived; listed explicit artifacts only.
Failures, refusals and negative cases remain in denominators. No comparative speed or statistical superiority claim.
